Read your original assignment for exact checkpoint, components, priorities and scope; its requirements remain. Inspect the current git diff against that checkpoint AND untracked production/test/quality files. Distinguish preexisting user edits described in original brief from campaign regressions. Inspect critical changed logic and tests for real assertions, permissive fakes, omitted failure cases, awkward refactors made solely to game complexity, denominator exclusions, mutation misclassification or weak anchors, stale/missing evidence and behavior regressions. Targets remain 90% lines,85% branches per production component and CRAP<=8 for EACH production function; no exceptions approved. Missing Swift branch counters must be honestly unverified. Do not approve project based on average CRAP or high overall coverage. Check saved final logs and source hashes, no tests/builds/mutations/UI/app/device execution. Read-only shell git/diff and small artifact arithmetic/hash checks allowed. No edits/delegation/branch/worktree/commit/push. Avoid dumping giant artifacts. Use repository final reports and saved checks; do NOT rerun suites just to recount. Review the complete changed scope, prioritizing critical contracts, and clearly disclose portions not inspected.
Corrections since first review are in repo reports. Three latest known report paths: Mac Dev/quality/RESULTS.md and Dev/quality/PROGRESS.md; Language reports/quality/HANDOFF.md and PROGRESS.md; Desktop quality/REPORT.md. Find Android/Zoomies current reports. Android/Zoomies task final messages were irrelevant greetings, so determine actual outcome from source/logs. Mac now claims maxCRAP8 and line>=90 all components; Language explicitly still fails frontend/Convex/lib gates. Independently verify claims rather than trusting them.
Important reviewer correction: your prior Zoomies NSNumber.intValue Int32 claim was FALSE on this supported macOS Swift platform. Parent probe returned type Int and4294967297 for NSNumber(Int64(4294967297)).intValue. Do not resurrect unsupported claim. Screenshot missing display ID silent failure was accepted for correction; verify.
Deliver one concise integrated report: current per-component coverage/maxCRAP/count>8, test and scoped mutation results with freshness; each actionable code issue with severity, exact path/line, concrete trigger, effect and evidence; target shortfalls separate from actual bugs; inspected scope/limits. Do not treat manual testing as work agent must execute. User owns it. No speculative claims or optional scope expansion. Complete within 1800sec with an honest bounded report if full inspection is too large.

{"reads": ["/Users/applelevne/Documents/coding-projects/language_duel"], "writes": []}

You are an external worker. Complete the assignment above within its constraints.
Your final response must be one JSON object with the fields below. Put any
requested exact answer or payload in summary or findings. Keep it concise but
retain details needed to use and verify your work. Use empty arrays when a field
has no entries. Do not invent evidence, file locations, checks, or success.

{
  "outcome": "complete | partial | blocked",
  "summary": "The result and what it means for the assignment.",
  "findings": ["Concrete findings, including relevant exact values."],

observed facts from hypotheses. For blocked or partial work, explain what is
missing and what would unblock it. Include important discoveries that affect
other work. Do not include private reasoning transcripts or routine tool chatter.
